name: MITRE ATT&CK for Mobile
description: Key mobile threat techniques used by MALINT-X for LLM-constrained analysis

techniques.name: Input Capture
techniques.description: Adversaries may use methods of capturing user input to obtain credentials or collect information.

techniques.name: Keylogging
techniques.description: Adversaries may log user keystrokes to intercept credentials or other information.

techniques.name: SMS Messages
techniques.description: Adversaries may collect SMS messages to steal OTPs or sensitive data.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols to avoid detection.

techniques.name: Web Protocols
techniques.description: Adversaries may communicate using HTTP/HTTPS to blend with normal traffic.

techniques.name: Multi-Stage Channels
techniques.description: Adversaries may create multiple stages for C2 to obfuscate the origin.

techniques.name: Input Capture
techniques.description: Adversaries may capture user input for credential theft on mobile devices.

techniques.name: Keylogging
techniques.description: Adversaries may log keystrokes on mobile for credential theft.

techniques.name: GUI Input Capture
techniques.description: Adversaries may mimic UI elements to capture credentials via overlays.

techniques.name: Archive Collected Data
techniques.description: Adversaries may compress and encrypt collected data before exfiltration.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.description: Adversaries may use standard protocols for data exfiltration.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries may exfiltrate data over existing C2 channels.

techniques.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
techniques.description: Adversaries may exploit vulnerabilities to escalate privileges.

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse elevation control mechanisms to gain higher privileges.

techniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may obfuscate payloads to evade detection.

techniques.name: Software Packing
techniques.description: Adversaries may pack software to hide malicious content.

techniques.name: Hide Artifacts
techniques.description: Adversaries may hide artifacts to evade detection.

techniques.name: Execution Guardrails
techniques.description: Adversaries may use guardrails to constrain execution to specific environments.

techniques.name: System Information Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may gather system information to aid targeting.

techniques.name: Software Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may enumerate installed software.

techniques.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may gather network configuration information.

techniques.name: Delete Device Data
techniques.description: Adversaries may delete device data for ransom or disruption.

techniques.name: Carrier Billing Fraud
techniques.description: Adversaries may use premium SMS or calls for billing fraud.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
techniques.description: Adversaries may configure auto-start to maintain persistence.

techniques.name: Event Triggered Execution
techniques.description: Adversaries may use event triggers (broadcast receivers) for persistence.

techniques.name: Deliver Malicious App via Other Means
techniques.description: Adversaries may deliver malicious apps through sideloading.
